tiles.title: P95 Client Query Latency
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns/1000000.0,0.95),3) AS p95_ms
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_kind_description='CLIENT' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("db.name", "db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database'

tiles.title: Trace Error Rate
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code=2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS error_rate_pct
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_kind_description='CLIENT' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("db.name", "db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database'

tiles.title: Top Statements by Executions
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "db.namespace" AS database, "db.query.text" AS query_text,
  SUM(CAST("mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.count_star" AS DOUBLE)) AS executions,
  SUM(CAST("mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.sum_timer_wait" AS DOUBLE))*1000.0 AS total_ms
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE "mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.count_star" IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND (COALESCE("db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database' OR "db.namespace" IS NULL)
GROUP BY database, query_text ORDER BY executions DESC LIMIT 25

tiles.title: Top Query Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "db.namespace" AS database, "db.query.text" AS query_text,
  SUM(CAST("mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.sum_timer_wait" AS DOUBLE))*1000.0 AS total_ms,
  SUM(CAST("mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.count_star" AS DOUBLE)) AS executions
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE "mysql.events_statements_summary_by_digest.count_star" IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND (COALESCE("db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database' OR "db.namespace" IS NULL)
GROUP BY database, query_text ORDER BY total_ms DESC LIMIT 20

tiles.title: Slow Query Log Volume
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COUNT(*) AS slow_log_lines
FROM $logs_dataset WHERE "log.file.name"='slow.log' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND (COALESCE("db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database' OR "db.namespace" IS NULL)
GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Recent Slow Query Log
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, body
FROM $logs_dataset WHERE "log.file.name"='slow.log' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND (COALESCE("db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database' OR "db.namespace" IS NULL)
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Log Volume by Source
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COALESCE("log.file.name", CASE WHEN "mysql.threads.thread_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'query_sample' ELSE 'top_query' END, 'unknown') AS log_source,
  COUNT(*) AS logs
FROM $logs_dataset WHERE COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND (COALESCE("db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database' OR "db.namespace" IS NULL)
GROUP BY time_bin, log_source ORDER BY time_bin, log_source

tiles.title: Errors & Warnings
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(body,'')) LIKE '%error%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(body,'')) LIKE '%failed%') AS errors,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(body,'')) LIKE '%warn%') AS warnings
FROM $logs_dataset WHERE COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND (COALESCE("db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database' OR "db.namespace" IS NULL)
GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Recent Error Log
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, severity_text, body
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE "log.file.name"='error.log' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND (COALESCE("db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database' OR "db.namespace" IS NULL)
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Active Query Samples
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, "db.namespace" AS database, "user.name" AS user_name,
  "mysql.session.status" AS session_status, "mysql.threads.processlist_command" AS command,
  ROUND("mysql.events_statements_current.timer_wait"*1000.0,3) AS elapsed_ms,
  "db.query.text" AS query_text, trace_id, span_id
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE "mysql.threads.thread_id" IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND (COALESCE("db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database' OR "db.namespace" IS NULL)
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Database Spans by Operation
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COALESCE(span_name,'unknown') AS operation, COUNT(*) AS spans
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_kind_description='CLIENT' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("db.name", "db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database'
GROUP BY time_bin, operation ORDER BY time_bin, operation

tiles.title: Query Latency Percentiles
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns/1000000.0,0.50),3) AS p50_ms,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns/1000000.0,0.95),3) AS p95_ms,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns/1000000.0,0.99),3) AS p99_ms
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_kind_description='CLIENT' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("db.name", "db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database'
GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Trace Errors
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COALESCE("event_exception.type",span_name,'unknown') AS error_type,
  COUNT(*) AS errors
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_kind_description='CLIENT' AND span_status_code=2 AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("db.name", "db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database'
GROUP BY time_bin, error_type ORDER BY time_bin, error_type

tiles.title: Latency by Operation
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT span_name AS operation, ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns)/1000000.0,3) AS avg_ms,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns/1000000.0,0.95),3) AS p95_ms
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_kind_description='CLIENT' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("db.name", "db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database'
GROUP BY operation ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

tiles.title: Slowest Database Spans
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, span_span_id, span_name AS operation,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns/1000000.0,3) AS duration_ms, span_status_description AS status,
  "db.name" AS database, "db.statement" AS statement
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_kind_description='CLIENT' AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("db.name", "db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database'
ORDER BY span_duration_ns DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Recent Trace Explorer
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, span_span_id, span_parent_span_id,
  span_name, span_kind_description, span_status_description,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns/1000000.0,3) AS duration_ms,
  "service.name" AS service, "db.name" AS database, "db.statement" AS statement
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("db.name", "db.namespace", 'unknown') ~ '$database'
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
